continuity: Owner source face and approved floral dress
Loup to owner left; keep screen direction

Small extra-fluffy Shih Tzu, no coat or breed changes

Frame 6: left hand above crown brushes fringe back, resting on fur surface. Dog eyes visible; no hand on or through torso. Right hand remains on phone.

beats.title: Waiting for her turn
beats.action: Medium two-shot; owner phone right ear; Loup eyes up. Small breath, no continuous bouncing.

beats.title: A gentle nudge
beats.action: Loup shifts weight and nudges left forearm once; owner glances down.

beats.title: Where did you go?
beats.action: Dog closeup; fringe settles over eyes. Hold briefly so obstruction reads.

beats.title: One quick shake
beats.action: Small head dip, short left-right shake; ears and fur lag then settle. Body stays supported on cushion.

beats.title: Still here
beats.action: Return two-shot; eyes now visible, single paw reaches left thigh; eager upward look.

beats.title: A little reassurance
beats.action: Owner looks down and gently sweeps fringe upward from Loup’s eyes with left fingertips on crown. Maintain clear shoulder/elbow/wrist connection. Right hand remains on phone.
